scripts.check: pnpm types:generate && pnpm --filter @astro-foundation/reference-site check && pnpm --filter @astro-foundation/core check
scripts.audit:deps: pnpm audit --prod || (echo '⚠ Dependency audit found vulnerabilities (see above). Review advisories; the gate does not hard-fail on transitive build-tool vulns (sharp/esbuild) that are not shipped in dist/.' && exit 0)
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @astro-foundation/reference-site exec playwright test tests/smoke/navigation.spec.ts tests/smoke/responsive.spec.ts
scripts.quality:fast: pnpm foundation:doctor && pnpm types:generate && pnpm theme:sync && pnpm theme:validate && pnpm routes:validate && pnpm content:validate && pnpm seo:validate && pnpm lint && pnpm test:unit
scripts.quality:page: pnpm quality:fast && pnpm build && echo "Checking generated artifact drift..." && git diff --exit-code -- examples/reference-site/src/theme/generated/ packages/astro-foundation/src/generated/
scripts.quality:release: pnpm quality:page && echo "Verifying rule traceability..." && pnpm traceability --check && echo "Parsing waivers..." && pnpm parse-waivers && echo "Scanning for secrets..." && pnpm secret-scan && echo "Auditing dependencies..." && pnpm audit:deps && echo "Running e2e tests..." && pnpm test:e2e && echo "Running a11y tests..." && pnpm test:a11y && echo "Running lighthouse..." && pnpm test:lighthouse
